value.rationale: The dodecahedron is a canonical 20-vertex Platonic cubic graph and antipodal double cover of the Petersen graph. The second-independence / \(P_3\)-devoid complex is a natural nonflag invariant beyond the known ordinary independence case, and its exact integral homotopy is not implied by the covered path/cycle/forest families or the quotient calculation. A primitive top-cell attaching map is essential. The claim is a motivated exact finite classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
